name: Campingplatz-Strandbad Wagner
beschreibung: The Campingplatz-Strandbad Wagner in Petting, Tirol, is located directly on the Pettinger Badesee in the Inntal. The location offers a wide view of the surrounding mountain ranges of the Kaisergebirge and the Kitzbüheler Alpen. Meadows and forests in the surrounding area create a peaceful atmosphere. Numerous hiking trails make the natural surroundings accessible; in winter, several ski areas in the region can be reached by car. The amenities include sanitary facilities, pitches with electricity and water connections as well as an included lido with sunbathing lawn. The lido allows direct swimming in the lake. The campsite serves as a starting point for exploring the Inntal and the Tiroler Bergwelt.
